column2: We have become Rome in all its greatness with the exception of one thing - Legions. If we can restore the ancient legions, no one can stop us.
The revival of the Roman legions

Again, like many millenia ago, columns of soldiers marching in the name of Rome, marking the return of a golden age for this land. [Root.GetTitledFirstName], using knowledge from ancient manuscripts and the advice of the best minds of Rome, was able to recreate the system of Roman Legions that are preparing to conquer America. And although the first Roman legion does not pose a particular threat, as Rome grows, more and more legionnaires will stand under the Roman flags.

Legio I Italica was the first Legion in Roman history, participating in many battles guarding Rome for centuries. And now, after many more centuries have passed since the fall of Rome, the First Roman Legion is again ready to protect the People of the Rome from barbarians, guaranteeing Rome will never fall again.
